_README: Static menu labels per screen class. The memory provider supplies the
exact selected index; this supplies the words. Together they replace
OCR + dHash + known_screens/ + highlight-colour calibration for any
IMPORTANT - index ordering is NOT verified yet. selectionTableIndex
indexes into the screen's mNavTable, and while that usually matches
visual top-to-bottom order, it is not guaranteed to. Verify each
screen live before trusting it: run `python memory_provider.py --probe`,
move the cursor one step at a time, and confirm the index increments
in the same direction as the visual selection. Getting this wrong
produces confidently-wrong narration, which is worse than none.
Provenance matters here - record where each list came from.

UIMainMenuScreen._provenance: Read directly from a full-resolution screenshot of the live game, 2026-09-08. An earlier sighted description of the same screen listed only 7 items ending in 'Quit to Main Menu' - the 8-item list here is from the screenshot and is believed correct, but the discrepancy is unresolved and worth confirming.
